description: This file contains a Python class for transforming audio transcription requests and responses between a custom format and the ElevenLabs API, specifically for speech-to-text functionality. It includes utilities for request data preparation, response parsing, environment validation, and URL generation, specialized for ElevenLabs service integration.

classes.name: ElevenLabsAudioTranscriptionConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for ElevenLabs speech-to-text API integration, providing methods for parameter mapping, request and response transformations, and environment validation.

methods.description: Returns an exception instance specific to ElevenLabs errors.

methods.name: AudioTranscriptionRequestData transform_audio_transcription_request( self, model: str, audio_file: FileTypes, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares the data and files for an audio transcription request to ElevenLabs API, processing the audio file and assembling form data.

methods.name: TranscriptionResponse transform_audio_transcription_response( self, raw_response: Response, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw response from ElevenLabs API into a structured TranscriptionResponse, extracting text and metadata.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
